newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo gold, platinum futures end firm as yen falls.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo gold, platinum futures end firm as yen falls.

text.p: Yen-based Tokyo gold and platinum futures reversed early losses to end mostly firmer on Friday, supported by the yen's retreat following comments by visiting U.S. Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin, traders said.
Gold futures ranged from one yen per gram lower to six yen firmer, with most-active benchmark February ending up six yen at 1,375 yen.

Platinum futures ranged fron 10 yen per gram lower to eight yen higher, with benchmark February finishing up five yen at 1,435 yen. "Individual investors, who were selling earlier, switched to buying on seeing the yen's slip," one trader said.
